# Exist

Exist is a personal analytics app that combines data from various services to help users understand and improve their lives.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/exist/.

## Actions

- **Exist OAuth2 Authorize** (read-only): Initiate the oauth2 authorization flow for user consent.
- **Exist OAuth2 Authorize** (read-only): Initiate the oauth2 authorization flow for user consent.
- **Get Attribute Templates** (read-only): Retrieve a paged list of supported attribute templates.
- **Get Correlations** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of recent correlations.
- **Get User Attributes** (read-only): Retrieve a paged list of the user's attributes without values.
- **Get User Profile** (read-only): Retrieve the authenticated user's profile details and preferences.
- **Get User Profile** (read-only): Retrieve the authenticated user's profile details and preferences.
